warning: Handshake packets contain dummy Noise bytes and are not valid Noise IK messages. AEAD keys are standalone deterministic examples, not Noise-derived traffic keys.
format_notes: Lowercase hex. Multibyte fields are big-endian except the packet number inside the AEAD nonce, which is uint64 little-endian.

data_aead.negative_tests: Flipping any header bit, or decrypting with path_id 8, MUST fail authentication.
